name: RapidWombat Integration
author: vadymhk

sections.description:
RapidWombat brings AI-powered content generation and visibility growth directly to your WordPress site. Connect your website once and automatically publish high-quality articles optimized for Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other AI-powered search engines. Build authority, attract organic traffic, earn quality backlinks, and grow your online presence without managing content teams, SEO agencies, or complex marketing workflows.

Key benefits

  • Automated content: AI-optimized content generation and publishing.
  • Increased visibility: Rank better in Google, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other answer engines.
  • Authority building: High-quality backlinks and authority-building infrastructure.
  • Link monitoring: Real-time website reputation and link monitoring.
  • AI support: AI-powered support agent to help convert visitors into customers.
  • Zero management: No marketing team, SEO expertise, or ongoing management required.

Connect your site once and let RapidWombat handle content growth, authority building, and AI search visibility on autopilot.

Third-Party Service (SaaS) Integration

This plugin acts as a secure receiver for the RapidWombat platform. It provides a dedicated REST endpoint for your WordPress site to receive and automatically publish content generated by your RapidWombat account.
* Service: RapidWombat
* Terms of Service: Terms of Service
* Privacy Policy: Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/rapidwombat-integration directory, or upload the ZIP via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new ‘RapidWombat’ menu in your WordPress sidebar. Copy the Integration Key.
  4. In your RapidWombat dashboard, paste the key into your integration settings to connect the site.
sections.faq:
Where do I find the Integration Key?

On the RapidWombat settings page in your WordPress admin area. The key is automatically generated upon plugin activation.

What is the endpoint URL?

Your endpoint will be https://yoursite.com/wp-json/rapidwombat/v1/publish. Test connectivity with /wp-json/rapidwombat/v1/ping.

What permissions are required?

Requests are authorized securely with the integration key only. No standard user login/password is required.
sections.changelog:
1.4.0

  • Fixed articles staying stale on the public page after being updated. The plugin now clears the cached copy of the article itself once it has been published, so visitors and search engines see the new version straight away.
  • Works with LiteSpeed Cache, WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, WP Fastest Cache, WP Super Cache, WP-Optimize, Cache Enabler, Super Page Cache, SiteGround Optimizer, Breeze and Nginx-based caches, whether or not automatic purging is switched on in those plugins.
  • Only the article and the pages it appears on are refreshed, so the rest of your site stays cached.

1.3.0

  • New articles can now arrive with their own category instead of all landing in one. The category is created on your site the first time it is used.
  • The Default Category setting still wins whenever you have picked one, so nothing changes for sites that already set it. Leave it on Automatic to let each article keep its own category.
  • An existing post is never re-filed on update, so a category you changed by hand in WordPress is kept.

1.1.0

  • Posts are now matched by the id RapidWombat stored when the article was first published, instead of by slug. Republishing an article whose headline changed, or whose permalink you edited in WordPress, updates the existing post instead of creating a duplicate.
  • The permalink of an existing post is no longer overwritten on update, so a slug you changed by hand is kept.
  • Fixed the featured image being removed from the article body when the image itself could not be downloaded, which left the post with no image at all.
  • Republishing an article with an unchanged image no longer adds another copy of that image to the media library.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Includes full secure integration with RapidWombat, SEO plugin support, and multilingual compatibility.
